answer: Persistent Resource Pulse Accounting. Each identity consumes a baseline of compute and storage that is metered continuously; operators must post a renewable resource lease per active identity. Sybil identities show a flat mesa of usage that never varies, unlike genuine agents whose activity spikes. On each accounting pulse, unused allocations decay toward a glacier of frozen reserves, and the operator loses the lease plus a penalty multiplier for every dormant clone. Cost per fake identity: full lease renewal plus decay penalty.
